readings: For each invoice, calculate the unrounded average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values and use its Customer.Country. Calculate the overall average as the unweighted average of those invoice-level averages. Define each invoice’s deviation as its average minus the overall average. Within each country, including a separate group for blank countries, average those deviations. Return the 10 invoices with the largest deviation minus their country’s average deviation. Show InvoiceId, country, invoice average UnitPrice, deviation, and deviation minus country average deviation. Sort the last value descending with blanks last, breaking ties by InvoiceId ascending.

For each invoice, calculate the unrounded average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values and use its Customer.Country. Calculate the overall average as the unweighted average of those invoice-level averages. Define each invoice’s deviation as the absolute difference between its average and the overall average. Within each country, including a separate group for blank countries, average those deviations. Return the 10 invoices with the largest deviation minus their country’s average deviation. Show InvoiceId, country, invoice average UnitPrice, deviation, and deviation minus country average deviation. Sort the last value descending with blanks last, breaking ties by InvoiceId ascending.

For each invoice, calculate the unrounded average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values and use its Customer.Country. Calculate the overall average from all InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values pooled across invoices, giving each line equal weight. Define each invoice’s deviation as its average minus that overall average. Within each country, including a separate group for blank countries, average those deviations. Return the 10 invoices with the largest deviation minus their country’s average deviation. Show InvoiceId, country, invoice average UnitPrice, deviation, and deviation minus country average deviation. Sort the last value descending with blanks last, breaking ties by InvoiceId ascending.

For each invoice, calculate the unrounded average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values and use its Customer.Country. Calculate the overall average from all InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values pooled across invoices, giving each line equal weight. Define each invoice’s deviation as the absolute difference between its average and that overall average. Within each country, including a separate group for blank countries, average those deviations. Return the 10 invoices with the largest deviation minus their country’s average deviation. Show InvoiceId, country, invoice average UnitPrice, deviation, and deviation minus country average deviation. Sort the last value descending with blanks last, breaking ties by InvoiceId ascending.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        c.Country AS country,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_average_unit_price,
        invoice_average_unit_price
            - (SELECT AVG(invoice_average_unit_price) FROM invoice_averages) AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
),
results AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_average_unit_price,
        deviation,
        deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (
            PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(country), '')
        ) AS deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    country,
    invoice_average_unit_price,
    deviation,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
FROM results
ORDER BY
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation IS NULL,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation DESC,
    InvoiceId ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        c.Country AS country,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_average_unit_price,
        ABS(invoice_average_unit_price - AVG(invoice_average_unit_price) OVER ()) AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_average_unit_price,
        deviation,
        deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (
            PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM(country), '')
        ) AS deviation_minus_country_average
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    country,
    invoice_average_unit_price,
    deviation,
    deviation_minus_country_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL,
    deviation_minus_country_average DESC,
    InvoiceId ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM InvoiceLine
),
invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(c.Country) = '' THEN NULL ELSE c.Country END AS country,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_avg_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_avg_unit_price,
        invoice_avg_unit_price - overall.avg_unit_price AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
    CROSS JOIN overall
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        country,
        invoice_avg_unit_price,
        deviation,
        deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    country,
    invoice_avg_unit_price,
    deviation,
    deviation_minus_country_avg
FROM scored
ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_avg IS NULL,
         deviation_minus_country_avg DESC,
         InvoiceId ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price
    FROM InvoiceLine
),
invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country AS country,
           AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, country, invoice_average,
           ABS(invoice_average - overall.average_price) AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
    CROSS JOIN overall
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, country, invoice_average, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY country)
               AS deviation_minus_country_average
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT InvoiceId, country, invoice_average, deviation,
       deviation_minus_country_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average IS NULL,
         deviation_minus_country_average DESC,
         InvoiceId ASC
LIMIT 10
